title: • To obtain products or services required
columns:
• As required or dictated by performance
contracts and/or agreements
• To obtain products or services required
for conducting Group business
• To maintain an ideal and timely supply
of goods and services for operations
• To encourage responsible practices
across our supply chain, local
procurement, supplier conduct and
environmental considerations
• To include critical suppliers in cross-
functional teams to contribute expertise
and advice before specifications are
developed for products or services

• One-on-one negotiations and
meetings for finalisation follow up
and after sales service
